b: おい - hey, rough male attention-getter
見ろ+よ (みろ+よ) - look (imperative of 見る) + よ (assertive "you know")
事故 (じこ) - accident
だ+ぜ - affirmative だ + ぜ (rough, confident male ending, like "hey")
lines.t: Hey, look! There's been an accident.

b: ひでぇ - contracted ひどい (terrible), the え-sound makes it rough
こっち+の+やつ+も (こっちのやつも) - this side + の + guy + also = this guy over here too
即死 (そくし) - instant death
だ+な - affirmative + な (muttering to oneself, seeking agreement)
lines.l: Terrible, this-side guy also instant-death is-hmm
lines.t: Awful. This one's dead on the spot too.

b: 泥濘 (ぬかるみ) - mud, a muddy patch of road
に - at/in (location of being stuck)
足を取られて (あしをとられて) - 足 foot + を + 取られて (passive te-form of 取る) = to have one's feet taken = to get one's feet caught
こんな - such a, this kind of
崖下 (がけした) - cliff + bottom = the foot of a cliff
まで - all the way to
落下した (らっかした) - fell (する-verb, past)
の+か - の (nominalizer, asks for explanation) + か (question), a musing question
lines.l: In mud feet were taken and so such cliff-bottom until fell, is it
lines.t: Did they get their feet stuck in the mud and fall all the way down to the bottom of this cliff?

b: にしても - even so, even granting that
さすが+は (さすがは) - as expected of; は adds emphasis on the topic
貴族 (きぞく) - noble
いい - good
身なり (みなり) - clothing, appearance
して+やがる (してやがる) - やがる is a rough/contemptuous attachment to a verb (here: する), expresses disdain or irritation at the subject
lines.l: Even so, as-expected-of nobles, good clothes are-wearing (contemptuous)
lines.t: Even so, you can tell they're nobles. They're dressed well, the bastards.

b: 旦那 (だんな) - master, "boss/mister", used to address a man politely
馬車の中 (ばしゃのなか) - horse carriage + の + inside = inside the carriage
女は死んでるけど (おんなはしんでるけど) - woman + は (contrast) + 死んでる (contracted 死んでいる, state of being dead) + けど (but)
赤ん坊 (あかんぼう) - baby
の+ほう (のほう) - the side of, "as for the baby side"; compares two sides
生きてる (いきてる) - contracted 生きている, is alive
よ - telling the listener something they might not know
lines.l: Boss, carriage inside woman dead-but, baby's side alive-you know
lines.t: Boss, the woman in the carriage is dead, but the baby is alive.

b: 子供 (こども) + を - child + object marker
庇った (かばった) - past of 庇う, to shield/protect
ん+だ+ね - ん = contracted の (explaining), だ, ね (seeking confirmation) = "it's that she..., right?"
この+人 (このひと) - this person (placed at the end, an afterthought for emphasis)
lines.t: She shielded her child, didn't she, this woman.

b: 赤ん坊 (あかんぼう) - baby, with ? the speaker repeats the word in disbelief
そんな+の (そんなの) - that kind of thing
ほっとき+やがれ - ほっとく (leave alone, contracted ほうっておく) → stem ほっとき + やがれ (rough imperative of やがる)
lines.t: A baby? Just leave it alone.

b: 何 (なに) - what
する - do
の+さ - の (soft explanatory) + さ (casual, slightly emphatic ending)
lines.t: What are you doing?

b: 決まって+んだろう (きまってんだろう) - 決まっている (be decided = obvious) → 決まってる → 決まってん + だろう. Contracted ん = の; "isn't it obvious?"
間抜け (まぬけ) - idiot
金目の+もの (かねめのもの) - 金目 (valuable, money-eyes) + の + thing = valuable things
を - object marker
いただく - 頂く, humble "to receive", used here ironically, "I'll be taking"
lines.l: Obvious isn't-it idiot, valuable things (I'll) receive
lines.t: Isn't it obvious, idiot? I'm taking the valuables.

b: なん+だ (なんだ) - what is
これ - this
は - topic marker
lines.t: What is this?

b: 気味の悪い (きみのわるい) - 気味 feeling + の + 悪い bad = creepy, unsettling
仮面 (かめん) - mask
だ - affirmative
き… - stuttering with fear
lines.t: W-what a creepy mask.

b: こいつ - this guy/thing (rough)
は - topic
いらねえ (いらねえ) - rough いらない, not needed
な - soft ending, talking to oneself
lines.t: I don't need this thing.

b: おい - hey
手伝え (てつだえ) - imperative of 手伝う, to help
前歯 (まえば) - front teeth
引っこ抜いて (ひっこぬいて) - te-form of 引っこ抜く, to yank out
歯医者 (はいしゃ) - dentist
に - to (destination)
持っていく (もっていく) - 持って (holding) + いく (go) = take along
ぞ - ぞ, strong masculine emphasis, announcing an intention
lines.l: Hey help, front-teeth yank-out and dentist to take-along-I-tell-you
lines.t: Hey, help me. We're pulling out the front teeth and taking them to a dentist.

b: 高く (たかく) - く-form of 高い (expensive), adverb "at a high price"
売る (うる) - to sell
ん+だ - explanatory のだ
lines.t: We'll sell them for a good price.

b: き… - stammering (the character is stuttering)
君 (きみ) - you (used by a superior to someone younger or lower)
君が (きみが) - が marks the subject you in "was it you who..."
介抱 (かいほう) - nursing, looking after an injured person
して+くれた (してくれた) - te-form + くれた (did a favor for me); here the し was dropped so the sentence reads 介抱しくれた
の+か - explanatory の + か question
lines.t: Y-you... was it you who took care of me?

b: ありがとう - thank you (casual/standard)
lines.t: Thank you.

b: 妻 (つま) + は - my wife + topic
妻と息子 (つまとむすこ) - wife + と (and) + son
二人 (ふたり) + は - two people + topic
無事 (ぶじ) - safe, unharmed
か - question
lines.l: Wife? Wife and son, the two of them safe?
lines.t: My wife... my wife and son. Are the two of them safe?

b: くたば… - くたばる, rough "to drop dead" (he nearly says something rude then stops himself)
あっ いや - oh, no (correcting himself)
ご夫人 (ごふじん) - madam, the lady (ご = honorific prefix)
と - and
御者 (ぎょしゃ) - coachman
は - topic
すでに - already
なくなって (亡くなって) - te-form of なくなる, "to pass away" (polite way to say died)
おりました - おる (humble います) + ました = humble past "were"
lines.l: ...(die) ah no, lady and coachman already passed-away-were
lines.t: They're... uh, no. The lady and the coachman had already passed away.

b: で…でも - stammered でも (but)
赤ちゃん (あかちゃん) - baby (softer than 赤ん坊)
は - contrast topic: "as for the baby"
無事 (ぶじ) + です - safe + polite です
lines.t: B-but the baby is safe.

b: これ+も (これも) - this too
運命 (うんめい) - fate
か - question particle used as a musing "I wonder if..."
lines.t: Is this too fate...?

b: 私 (わたし) + の + 名 (な) + は - my name + topic
ジョースター - the name Joestar, spoken as the predicate (だ omitted for formality)
命 (いのち) + を - life + object
救って (すくって) + くれた - saved + did for me
礼 (れい) - gratitude, thanks, a reward
を+したい - want to do (たい-form of する)
lines.l: My name-as-for Joestar. Life saved-for-me thanks want-to-do
lines.t: My name is Joestar. I want to thank you for saving my life.

b: また - again
気を失う (きをうしなう) - 気 consciousness + を + 失う lose = to pass out
前に (まえに) - before
あなた - you
の - possessive particle: あなたの = "your"
名 (な) - name. On its own, 名 read な is the formal/dramatic word for "name" (everyday word: 名前 なまえ)
を - object marker: shows 名 is the thing being heard, so 名を聞かせて = "let me hear (your) name"
聞かせて (きかせて) + ほしい - causative te-form of 聞く, "let (me) hear" + ほしい (I want) = I want you to let me hear (tell me)
lines.l: Again consciousness lose before, your name let-me-hear want
lines.t: Before I pass out again, I'd like you to tell me your name.

b: こいつ - this guy (rough)
オレ + を - I (rough, katakana for a rougher tone) + object
命の恩人 (いのちのおんじん) - life's benefactor = the person who saved my life
と - quotes the thought
思った (おもった) + よう+だ + な - thought + seems (ようだ) + な
lines.l: This guy me life's-benefactor thought seems-hmm
lines.t: It looks like this guy thinks I'm the one who saved his life.

b: この - this
バカ - fool
め - め attached to a noun, contempt, "you fool"
lines.t: What an idiot.

b: 名乗って (なのって) - te-form of 名乗る, to give one's name
損 (そん) - loss, disadvantage
は - contrast, "at least not"
なかろう - classical/literary negative guess form of ない ("probably isn't"), used in a stiff, theatrical way
lines.t: There's no harm in giving my name.

b: ダリオ・ブランドー - the name, Dario Brando
と - quotes the name
言い+やす (いいやす) - 言います in a rough, streetwise dialect (やす replacing ます), a servile "common man" voice
lines.t: The name's Dario Brando, sir.

b: ミスター ブランドー - Mister Brando
この+ジョースター - this Joestar; speaking of oneself by name for solemnity
決して (けっして) - never (always used with a negative)
恩 (おん) + を - favor/debt of gratitude + object
忘れ+は+しまい (わすれはしまい) - 忘れる stem + は (emphasis) + しまい (negative volitional, "will not")
lines.l: Mr. Brando, this Joestar never the-debt will-not-forget
lines.t: Mr. Brando, I, Joestar, will never forget this debt.

b: よーし - よし stretched, "good!" (to a dog or child)
いい子 (いいこ) - good boy/girl
だ - affirmative
lines.t: Good boy.

b: 父さん (とうさん) - dad (casual address; さん, not a formal お)
行ってきます (いってきます) - 行って (go) + 来ます (come) = "I'll go and come back", the set phrase on leaving home
lines.t: Dad, I'm off.

b: 気を付ける (きをつける) - to be careful
ん+だ+ぞ - explanatory ん + だ + ぞ (firm advice from a father)
ジョジョ - the nickname being called
lines.t: Be careful, Jojo.

b: 行く (いく) + よ - go + assertive よ
ダニー - the name of the dog
lines.t: Let's go, Danny.

b: ディオ - Dio
ここ+へ (ここへ) - to here (へ marks direction)
来い (こい) - imperative of 来る (rough command)
聞こえ+ねえ (きこえねえ) - rough 聞こえない, can't hear
の+か - rhetorical question, "don't you hear?" (angry)
lines.t: Dio, come here! Dio, can't you hear me?

b: なん+だい (なんだい) - "what is it?", だい is a softer, male-ish question ending
父さん (とうさん) - dad
lines.t: What is it, Dad?

b: 薬 (くすり) - medicine
かい - casual male question ending (like か + い)
lines.t: Is it your medicine?

b: バカヤロー - "you idiot!" (rough insult, バカ野郎 stretched)
そんな - such a
効き+も+しない (ききもしない) - stem of 効く (to work, be effective) + も (emphasis between stem and する) + しない = doesn't even work
薬 (くすり) - medicine
いらねえ (いらない) - rough, don't need
ん+だ+よ - explanatory ん + だ + assertive よ
lines.l: You idiot, that-kind-of doesn't-even-work medicine isn't-needed-it-is
lines.t: You idiot! I don't need medicine that doesn't even work.

b: 酒 (さけ) + だ - alcohol + is
薬買う金 (くすりかうかね) - 薬 + 買う (buy) + 金 (money) = money to buy medicine; the verb before the noun explains it
あったら - ある (to have) + たら (conditional "if") = if there is
酒 + 買って (かって) + こい - alcohol, buy (te-form) + 来い = go buy and come back
lines.l: It's alcohol. If there's money for buying medicine, buy alcohol and come back
lines.t: Booze! If you've got money for medicine, go buy me booze.

b: ジョジョ - the name
マナー - manners, short reprimand (a noun alone as a rebuke)
lines.t: Jojo, manners.

b: ごめんなさい - sorry (polite-casual, child speech)
lines.t: I'm sorry.

b: チェック - check (chess), said with checkmate in mind
lines.t: Check.

b: ほら - look/here
よ - assertive
lines.t: Here you go.

b: いい - good
様 (ざま) - rough "state, figure". 様 read さま is "manner", but ざま is derogatory: "what a sight"
だ+な - is + muttering
クソ+ガキ (クソガキ) - shit + kid = brat
lines.t: Serves you right, you little brat.

b: やめて - te-form of やめる, "stop (it)"
返して (かえして) - te-form of 返す, "give back", the te-form alone becomes a request/plea
返して - repeated for emotion
lines.t: Stop! Give it back! Give it back!

b: 取り返して (とりかえして) - te-form of 取り返す, retake
みろ - imperative of みる (try), てみろ = "try to do it"
lines.t: Go on, try and take it back.

b: おい - hey
エリナ - Erina
この+人形 (このにんぎょう) - this doll
買って (かって) + もらった - bought (te-form) + received = "had it bought for me"
の+か - explanatory の + か
lines.l: Hey Erina, this doll had-it-bought-for-you, is it?
lines.t: Hey, Erina. Did someone buy you this doll?

b: お前 (おまえ) + の + 親父 (おやじ) - you + の + dad (rough "old man")
ヤブ医者 (ヤブいしゃ) - quack doctor
の+くせに - despite being, with a tone of contempt
儲けて+っ+から+な (もうけてっからな) - 儲けている contracted to 儲けてる, then 儲けてっから (casual from); から = because; な
lines.t: Your dad's a quack, yet he's raking it in.

b: どうだ - how about it
よし - alright
人形 (にんぎょう) の 服 (ふく) を - the doll's clothes (object)
脱がせて (ぬがせて) + やる - causative te-form of 脱ぐ (undress) + やる (give; I'll do it for you)
ぜ - rough emphasis
lines.l: How about it, good, doll's clothes undress-make I'll do
lines.t: How about it? Alright, I'll take your doll's clothes off.

b: あそこ - that place (euphemism for the genitals)
が - subject
本物 (ほんもの) と 同じ (おなじ) - real thing + と + same
か+どうか - whether or not
見て (みて) + やる - look + I'll do it for you
lines.l: That place (as subject) whether same as real or not, look I'll do
lines.t: I'll check whether it's the same as a real one.

b: 泣いた (ないた) - past of 泣く, cried
lines.t: (She) cried.

b: エリナ - name, repeated as teasing
泣き虫 (なきむし) - 泣き (stem of 泣く, cry) + 虫 (bug) = crybaby
lines.t: Erina, Erina, crybaby Erina!

b: やめろ - imperative of やめる, "stop it"
lines.t: Stop it!

b: 人形 (にんぎょう) + を - doll (object)
返して (かえして) + やる - give back (te-form) + やる (do for someone, here as a firm intent)
ん+だ - explanatory んだ, "you have to / I'm telling you"
lines.t: Give the doll back to her.

b: なん+だ (なんだ) - what is
お前 (おまえ) - you (rough)
lines.t: Who the hell are you?

b: エリナ+の (エリナの) - Erina's
知り合い (しりあい) - acquaintance, from 知り合う (to get to know each other)
か - question
lines.t: A friend of Erina's?

b: 知らない (しらない) - don't know
子 (こ) - child, girl
だが (written だか) - but; the subtitle has a typo of だが
僕 (ぼく) + に+は - I (polite-ish male) + for (に) + contrast は
戦う (たたかう) + 理由 (りゆう) - fight + reason = reason to fight
が+ある - exists
lines.l: Don't-know girl but, for me fight-reason exists
lines.t: I don't know this girl, but I have a reason to fight.

b: こ…の…やろう - この野郎 (konoyarou) broken up by pain; やろう means guy/bastard
lines.t: Y-you bastard...

b: 女の子 (おんなのこ) + の + 前 (まえ) - girl + の + in front of = in front of a girl
だ+から - is + because
lines.t: Because it's in front of a girl.

b: なんで - why
こいつ - this guy (rough)
てんで - not at all (always followed by a negative, here 弱い, so it reads as a strong emphasis)
弱い (よわい) - weak
ぞ - rough emphasis, noticing something
lines.t: Why? This guy is totally weak!

b: これ+以上 (これいじょう) - more than this
惨めな (みじめな) + こと - miserable + thing (な connects a な-adjective to a noun)
が+あろう+か (があろうか) - あろう (classical volitional of ある, "could there be") + か = rhetorical question: "could there be...?"
lines.t: Could anything be more miserable than this?

b: 助け (たすけ) + に - stem of 助ける + に (purpose) = to help
入って (はいって) - te-form of 入る, step in
逆に (ぎゃくに) - on the contrary
やられて+やがる (やられてやがる) - やられる (passive of やる, be beaten) + やがる (contempt)
lines.t: He steps in to help and ends up getting beaten instead.

b: こいつ - this guy
ジョースター家 (ジョースターけ) - the Joestar family (家 read け in family names)
の - possessive
一人息子 (ひとりむすこ) - only son
だ - is
lines.l: This guy, Joestar family's only son is
lines.t: This guy's the Joestar family's only son.

b: オレ+は (オレは) - I (rough)
金持ち (かねもち) + に - rich person + に (towards)
恨み (うらみ) + は+ねえ - grudge + contrast + rough ない = I hold no grudge
が - but
とにかく - anyway
嫌い (きらい) + だ - dislike, is
lines.l: I toward rich people grudge-as-for none but anyway dislike
lines.t: I've got no grudge against the rich, but I just hate them.

b: お高く (おたかく) - お + 高く (high-handedly)
とまる (止まる) - 気取る, "put on airs" is お高くとまる, "to act stuck-up"
な+ん+じゃ+ねえ+ぜ (なんじゃねえぜ) - negative imperative な ("don't") + んじゃねえ (rough ではない)
lines.t: Don't get high and mighty.

b: 思い知れ (おもいしれ) - imperative of 思い知る, to be made to realize the hard way
lines.t: Remember this!

b: ディオ - Dio (calling)
俺 (おれ) + は - I + topic
もう - already, anymore
長い (ながい) + こと+は+ねえ (ことはねえ) - long (time) + thing + contrast + rough ない = not long left
わかる+ん+だ - understand + explanatory = I just know
lines.l: Dio, I already long-thing-as-for don't-have, I know it
lines.t: Dio, I don't have long left. I can tell.

b: 俺が死んだら (おれがしんだら) - 死ぬ past + ら (conditional) = when/if I die
この+手紙 (このてがみ) + を - this letter (object)
出して (だして) - te-form of 出す, post/mail
宛名 (あてな) + の + ところ+へ - address + の + place + to
ジョースター家 (ジョースターけ) + へ - to the Joestar family
行け (いけ) - imperative of 行く
lines.l: If I die, this letter mail-and, to the address place, to Joestar family go
lines.t: When I die, mail this letter and go to the address, the Joestar house.

b: こいつ+は (こいつは) - this guy (topic) = Joestar
俺 (おれ) + に - toward me
恩 (おん) + が+ある - debt of gratitude + exists = owes me a favor
ん+だ - explanatory
lines.l: This guy toward me a-favor exists-it-is
lines.t: This guy owes me a favor.

b: お前 (おまえ) + は - you (topic)
頭 (あたま) + が+いい - head + subject + good = smart
誰 (だれ) + に+も - to anyone
負けねぇ (まけねぇ) - rough 負けない, won't lose
一番 (いちばん) + の + 金持ち (かねもち) + に+なれ - number-one + rich person + become (imperative)
よ - assertive
lines.l: You smart, to anyone won't lose, number-one rich-person become-you-know
lines.t: You're smart and you'll lose to no one. Become the richest man of all.

b: 金持ち (かねもち) + は - rich people (topic)
テメエ - てめえ, rough "you/yourself"
の+敷地内 (しきちない) + だけ+で - premises-inside + only + at
遊び (あそび) + やがれ - stem of 遊ぶ + やがれ (rough command: "go play!")
lines.l: Rich people, in own premises only go-play (contempt)
lines.t: Rich people should keep their games inside their own grounds.

b: 行こう (いこう) - volitional of 行く
ぜ - rough emphasis
lines.t: Let's go.

b: あ…あの - hesitant "um..." used to address someone
lines.t: U-um...

b: いい+から (いいから) - "never mind, it's fine, just..."
ほっとい+て (ほっといて) - te-form of ほっとく (leave alone), a request: "leave me alone"
向こう (むこう) + へ - over there + to
行け (いけ) + よ - imperative of 行く + assertive よ
lines.t: Never mind. Leave me alone. Go away.

b: 僕 (ぼく) + は - I + topic
君 (きみ) + に - you (the agent)
感謝 (かんしゃ) + され+たくって - gratitude + passive (be thanked) + たい (want) te-form (casual)
あいつら + に+向かって (にむかって) - those guys + towards (against)
向かって+いった (むかっていった) - went toward them
ん+じゃあ+ない+ぞ - explanatory ん + じゃ (casual では, lengthened) + ない + ぞ
lines.l: I, because-I-wanted-to-be-thanked-by-you, toward those guys went-it-isn't
lines.t: I didn't go up against those guys because I wanted you to thank me.

b: 僕 + は - I + topic
本当の (ほんとうの) - real, true
紳士 (しんし) + を - gentleman (object)
目指して (めざして) + いる - te-form of 目指す (aim for) + いる = am aiming
から+だ (からだ) - because it is (the reason)
lines.t: It's because I'm aiming to be a true gentleman.

b: 君 (きみ) + が - you (subject)
女の子 (おんなのこ) + で - girl + te-form of だ (and)
困って (こまって) + いた - was in trouble (continuous past)
から+だ - because
lines.t: It's because you were a girl in trouble.

b: 相手 (あいて) + が - opponent (subject)
大きい (おおきい) + やつ+だから+って - big + guy + because + って (even if "just because")
負ける (まける) + と - lose + quote
分かって (わかって) + いる+から+って - understand + because + even if = even though I know I'll lose
紳士 (しんし) + は - a gentleman (topic)
勇気 (ゆうき) + を+もって - with courage (もって = by means of)
戦わ (たたかわ) + なくては+ならない - must fight (なくてはならない = must)

気安く (きやすく) - casually
呼んで (よんで) + くれる - calls (for me, ironic)
じゃ+ー+ない+か (じゃーないか) - じゃないか with extended ー (sarcasm)
lines.l: Someone's name quite casually you-call-me, aren't you
lines.t: You're calling someone's name awfully casually, aren't you?

b: 決して (けっして) - never
許さない (ゆるさない) - negative of 許す
lines.t: I will never forgive you.

b: 君 (きみ) + の + 僕 (ぼく) + に+対する (にたいする) - your toward-me
嫌がらせ (いやがらせ) - harassment
では+ない (ではない) - it's not
lines.l: Your harassment toward me isn't it
lines.t: It's not about the way you harass me.

b: 僕 + の + こと+など (ことなど) - about me and the like
どうでもいい - doesn't matter
lines.l: About me and such, doesn't matter
lines.t: What happens to me doesn't matter.

b: さては - so that's it (realizing)
聞いた (きいた) + な - heard + な (accusation)
あの - that
愛しの (いとしの) - beloved (古風 literary)
エリナ+の+こと+を (エリナのことを) - about Erina
lines.l: So that's it, you heard, about that beloved Erina
lines.t: So you heard it, about your beloved Erina.

b: そして - and
鉄拳 (てっけん) + に+よる (による) - by iron fist (violence)
報復 (ほうふく) + に+出る (にでる) - take revenge
こと+を (ことを) - the matter (object)
考えた (かんがえた) + わけ+か (わけか) - thought; わけか = "is it that..."
lines.l: And by iron fist revenge to take, thought, is that it
lines.t: And so you thought you'd take revenge with your fists.

b: 彼女 (かのじょ) + に+対する (にたいする) - toward her
侮辱 (ぶじょく) + が - insult (subject)
許さない (ゆるさない) - can't forgive
Note: the が should normally be を; it is a stylistic or a subtitle quirk. Here the insult (subject) can't be forgiven.
lines.t: I can't forgive the insult toward her.

b: 見苦しい (みぐるしい) + ぞ - unseemly + emphasis
嫉妬 (しっと) + に - jealousy (cause)
狂った (くるった) - gone mad
姿 (すがた) + は - figure (topic), placed last for effect
lines.t: It's ugly. You, mad with jealousy.

b: また - again
ボクシング+の+よう+に (ボクシングのように) - like the boxing (earlier)
され+たい (されたい) - passive of する + たい (want) = want to be treated
の+か - explanatory + question
間抜け (まぬけ) + が - idiot
lines.l: Again like the boxing want-to-be-treated? Idiot
lines.t: Do you want me to treat you like in the boxing match again, you idiot?

b: か…かなわない - 敵わない (can't match), stuttering at the start
lines.t: I-I can't beat him.

b: でも - but
ここ+で (ここで) - here
負けた+ら (まけたら) - if I lose
これから - from now on
一生 (いっしょう) - whole life
ディオ+の+影 (かげ) + で - in Dio's shadow
おどおど+と (おどおどと) - timidly
生活 (せいかつ) + しなくては+ならない - must live (なくてはならない)
lines.l: But if I lose here, from now my whole life in Dio's shadow timidly I must live
lines.t: But if I lose here, I'll have to live timidly in Dio's shadow for the rest of my life.

b: 何 (なに) + より+も (よりも) - more than anything
エリナ+の+名誉 (めいよ) + を - Erina's honor (object)
取り戻す (とりもどす) + ため - in order to take back
戦わ (たたかわ) + なくては+ならない - must fight
lines.l: More than anything, to take back Erina's honor, I must fight
lines.t: Above all, I have to fight to restore Erina's honor.

b: 徹底的に (てっていてきに) - thoroughly
叩きのめして (たたきのめして) + やる - beat down + I'll do it
それも - and that, too
正々堂々 (せいせいどうどう) + と - fair and square
な - soft male ending
lines.l: Thoroughly I'll beat him down. And that fair and square
lines.t: I'll beat you down completely, and fairly, too.

b: そう+する (そうする) + こと+に+よって (ことによって) - by doing so
自分 (じぶん) + は - oneself (Jojo)
もう - anymore
この+ディオ+に+は (このディオには) - against this Dio
勝てない (かてない) - can't win
と+いう + こと+を (ということを) - the fact that
ジョジョ自身 (ジョジョじしん) + の + 体 (からだ) + で - with Jojo's own body
覚える (おぼえる) + から+だ - learn + because
喧嘩 (けんか) + でも + 人生 (じんせい) + でも + な - both in fights and in life
lines.l: By doing so, the fact that Jojo can no longer beat this Dio, with Jojo's own body he'll learn, because. In fights and in life
lines.t: That way, Jojo will learn with his own body that he can't beat me, in fights or in life.

b: こい (来い) - imperative of 来る: come
lines.t: Come on.

b: いい+ぞ (いいぞ) - good!
いい + 感触 (かんしょく) + だ - good feel
lines.t: Good. That felt good.

b: こ…こいつ - stammering "t-this guy"
蹴り (けり) + を - kick (object)
入れられて (いれられて) - passive te-form: having been kicked in
掴んで (つかんで) + くる + とは - grab (te-form) + come + とは (surprise)
lines.l: This guy, having been kicked, even grabs on, to think
lines.t: This guy... he grabs me even after being kicked?

b: もう - once more
一撃 (いちげき) - one blow
ほしい (ほしい) + か - want + question
lines.t: Do you want another hit?

b: ディオ - name
ォォォォォ━━━━ - drawn-out shout
！！ - exclamation
lines.t: Dioooo!

b: こんな - such a, this kind of
こんな - repeated
カス+みたいな (カスみたいな) - like scum
やつ+に (やつに) - by a guy
この+ディオ+が (このディオが) - this Dio (subject), left unfinished
lines.l: Such, such a scum-like guy, this Dio...
lines.t: Someone like this scum, defeating me, Dio...

b: 君 (きみ) + が - you (subject)
泣く (なく) + まで - until you cry
殴る (なぐる) + の+を+やめない (のをやめない) - don't stop hitting
lines.l: Until you cry, hitting I won't stop
lines.t: I won't stop hitting you until you cry.

b: よ…よくも - how dare you (よくも + verb = expression of indignation)
よくも よくも よくも - repeated
この+僕 (このぼく) + に+向かって (にむかって) - toward me (the dignified)
lines.l: How dare you, how dare you... to me
lines.t: How dare you, how dare you... to me!

b: な…涙 (なみだ) - tears
lines.t: T-tears...

b: この - this
汚らしい (きたならしい) - filthy
アホ+が (アホが) - idiot (contemptuous が)
lines.t: You filthy fool!

b: 二人とも (ふたりとも) - both of you
いったい - on earth
何ごと (なにごと) + だ - what matter
lines.l: Both of you on earth what matter
lines.t: What on earth is going on, you two?

b: 父さん (とうさん) - Dad
lines.t: Dad!

b: 男子 (だんし) + たる + もの (たるもの) - one who is a (boy/man); たる = old copula
喧嘩 (けんか) + の + 一つ (ひとつ) + も - even one fight
する + だろう - will do + probably
lines.l: One who's a boy, even one fight, would have
lines.t: Any boy would get into a fight or two.

b: しかし - however
ジョジョ - name
今 (いま) + の + は - just now
抵抗 (ていこう) + も + できなくなった (できなくなった) - became unable even to resist
ディオ + を - Dio (object)
一方的に (いっぽうてきに) - one-sidedly
殴って (なぐって) + いた - was hitting
よう+に (ように) - as if
見えた (みえた) - looked
紳士 (しんし) + の + する + こと+では+ない - not a thing a gentleman does
lines.l: However Jojo: just now it looked like you were one-sidedly beating Dio, who could no longer resist. Not what a gentleman does
lines.t: But Jojo, just now it looked like you were one-sidedly beating a Dio who could no longer resist. That's not what a gentleman does.

b: ち…違う (ちがう) - stammered "that's not right"
lines.t: N-no!

b: 言い訳 (いいわけ) + 無用 (むよう) - excuses + unnecessary
二人とも (ふたりとも) - both
部屋 (へや) + へ - to the room
入っ+とれ (はいっとれ) - 入っておれ in dialect-ish elder speech: "stay in"
lines.l: Excuses unnecessary. Both of you into the room, stay
lines.t: No excuses. Both of you, go to your room.

b: 後で (あとで) - later
二人とも (ふたりとも) - both of you
罰 (ばつ) + を - punishment
与える (あたえる) - give
lines.l: Later both of you punishment I'll give
lines.t: Later, I'll punish both of you.

b: あの - that
箱 (はこ) - box
何やら (なにやら) - something (is) (odd)
lines.t: That box... something about it...

b: まぁ+いい+か (まぁいいか) - well, never mind
メイド+の+誰か (メイドのだれか) - one of the maids
が - subject
当てた (あてた) - 宛てた: addressed/delivered
ん+じゃろう (んじゃろう) - an older man's dialect だろう: "probably"
lines.l: Well, never mind. One of the maids addressed it, probably
lines.t: Oh well. One of the maids must have sent for it.

b: な…なんだ - stammered "what is"
この - this
ぶつかる+ような (ぶつかるような) - like colliding
音 (おと) + は - sound (topic)
lines.t: W-what is this thumping sound?

b: ま…まさか - no way
な…中 (なか) + に - inside
誰か (だれか) + いる + の+だ (いるのだ) - someone is there (explanatory)
lines.t: N-no way... someone's inside!

b: た…大変 (たいへん) + だ - terrible
生きた (いきた) + まま - while alive
焼かれて (やかれて) + いる - being burned (passive te-form)
の+だ - explanatory
lines.t: It's terrible. They're being burned alive!

b: エリナ - name
lines.t: Erina...

b: クソ - damn
ディオ - Dio
lines.t: Damn you, Dio.

b: お前 (おまえ) + の + くだらない + キス+は (キスは) - your worthless kiss
これ+を (これを) - this (object)
狙って (ねらって) + いた + の+なら (のなら) - if you were aiming (conditional)
予想以上 (よそういじょう) + の - beyond expectation
効果 (こうか) + は - effect
上げた (あげた) + ぞ - achieved + emphasis
lines.l: Your worthless kiss, if aiming at this, beyond-expectation effect you achieved
lines.t: If your worthless kiss was aiming for this, it worked better than you expected.

b: あまり+に (あまりに) - too
ひどい (ひどい) + 亡骸 (なきがら) + だった + ので - such a terrible corpse
お前 (おまえ) + に+は (には) - to you
見せず (みせず) + に - without showing (the subtitle writes 見ぜず, a typo of 見せず)
埋葬 (まいそう) + した + よ - buried
lines.l: It was a too-terrible corpse so, without showing you, buried
lines.t: The body was too awful, so I buried her without showing you.

b: 警察 (けいさつ) + が - police
言う (いう) + に+は (には) - according to what they say
おそらく - probably
番犬 (ばんけん) + が - watchdog (subject)
じゃま + な - being a nuisance
盗人 (ぬすびと) + の + 仕業 (しわざ) + だろう - thief's doing + probably
と+いう + こと+だ (ということだ) - they say / that's what it is
lines.l: Police by what-they-say, probably a thief for whom the watchdog was an obstacle did it, so it is said
lines.t: The police say it was probably a thief who found the watchdog in the way.

b: ディオ - name
lines.t: Dio.

b: ディオ+さん (ディオさん) + ? - Mr. Dio, with rising intonation
まだ - still
学校 (がっこう) + から - from school
帰って (かえって) + おりません (おりません) - おる (humble いる) + ません
が - but (softener)
lines.l: Dio? Still from school hasn't-returned, but
lines.t: Master Dio? He hasn't come back from school yet.

b: ジョジョ+は (ジョジョは) - Jojo
自分 (じぶん) + の + 部屋 (へや) + へ - to his own room
行き (いき) - stem of 行く, connecting
二時間 (にじかん) + 眠った (ねむった) - slept two hours
lines.l: Jojo to own room went and slept two hours
lines.t: Jojo went to his own room and slept for two hours.

b: そして - and
目を覚まして (めをさまして) + から - after waking up
しばらく+して (しばらくして) - after a while
ダニー+が (ダニーが) - Danny (subject)
死んだ (しんだ) + こと+を (ことを) - the fact he died
思い出し (おもいだし) - remembered (stem)
泣いた (ないた) - cried
lines.l: And after waking, after a while, remembered that Danny had died, and cried
lines.t: After waking up, some time later he remembered Danny had died, and cried.

b: バカ犬 (バカいぬ) + を - idiot dog (object)
始末 (しまつ) + し - dispose of (stem)
屈辱 (くつじょく) + は - humiliation (topic)
晴らした (はらした) + が - cleared + but
あんな + 爆発力 (ばくはつりょく) + が - such explosive power (subject)
ジョジョ+に (ジョジョに) + ある + とは - Jojo has it, to think
見くびって (みくびって) + いた - had underestimated
lines.l: Idiot dog disposed, humiliation cleared, but such explosive power Jojo has, to think; had underestimated
lines.t: I got rid of the stupid dog and avenged the humiliation, but I underestimated that explosive power in Jojo.

b: やつ+は (やつは) - that guy
叩けば (たたけば) + 叩く (たたく) + ほど - the more you hit
成長 (せいちょう) + する - grow
タイプ + だ - type
lines.t: He's the type who grows the more you beat him down.

b: 自分 (じぶん) + の + 欠点 (けってん) + は - own flaw
怒りっぽい (おこりっぽい) + ところ + だ - short-tempered part
反省 (はんせい) + しなくては - must reflect (しなくては)
... (omitted ならない)
lines.l: Own flaw is the short-tempered part; I must reflect
lines.t: My flaw is my temper. I must reflect on it.

b: もっと - more
自分 (じぶん) + の + 心 (こころ) + を - own heart
冷静に (れいせいに) - calmly
コントロール + する + よう+に (ように) - so as to control
成長 (せいちょう) + しなくては - must grow
lines.l: More, own heart calmly to-control, must grow
lines.t: I need to grow so that I can control my heart calmly.

b: そして - and
七年 (ななねん) + の + 歳月 (さいげつ) - seven years of time
が - subject
経過 (けいか) + する - elapse
lines.l: And seven years of time elapses
lines.t: And seven years pass.
